title: DRESS: Instructing Large Vision-Language Models to Align and Interact with Humans via Natural Language Feedback
reasoning: The paper identifies 'harmlessness' as a core alignment objective, which it defines as ensuring model responses align with human ethics and values. It introduces the VLSafe dataset specifically to train and evaluate the model's ability to resist generating harmful or unethical content, making moral and ethical alignment a primary component of its methodology and evaluation.
